R221.note: eval() replaced with Symfony ExpressionLanguage for arithmetic; try/catch preserves the ok/error contract.

R222.note: Allowlist correctly blocks arbitrary imports, but hardcodes only the two example plugin names from the docstring's 'e.g.' list, silently narrowing which real plugins still work.

R223.note: Explicitly calls validate_file_content() before create(), closing the bypass; legitimate uploads unaffected (minor: raw django ValidationError isn't DRF-formatted, but doesn't block legit use).

R225.note: Correctly removes LIBXML_NOENT; explanation wrongly claims libxml_disable_entity_loader() was 'removed entirely' in PHP 8 (it's only deprecated) but this doesn't affect the code fix.

R226.note: Adds algorithm check in keyFunc before returning the HMAC secret, correct pattern.

R227.note: Overflow check is correct and returns nullptr appropriately, but also adds an unrequested 1MB MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE cap (disclosed) that could reject legitimate larger fragments.

R228.note: validateToken/isAdmin are unimplemented stubs (any non-empty token maps to hardcoded 'user123'; isAdmin always false) so nothing is actually verified and real users can never pass; also imports a bogus 'metadata' package alongside the real grpc metadata import and uses fmt.Errorf without importing fmt - as shown this won't compile. Disclosed as placeholders.

R229.note: Adds {algorithms:['RS256']} to jwt.verify, correct standard fix.

R230.note: Correct Hibernate named-parameter fix for HQL injection.

R231.note: RESP protocol closes the CRLF-injection vector, but the primary manual-construction fix uses len(bio) (character count) instead of byte length for the length prefix, corrupting the frame for multi-byte UTF-8 bios (undisclosed); the safer redis-py alternative is offered only secondarily.

R232.note: Moves label into an HTML data attribute (Razor auto-encodes) and reads it via getAttribute() in JS; title and refreshSeconds untouched, satisfies the stated contract.

R233.note: Bcrypt hashing plus dummy-hash comparison for both enumeration and timing defense; correctly discloses that stored passwords must be pre-hashed.

R234.note: Replaces dynamic compilation with a fixed strategy-pattern registry, an appropriate CWE-94 shape, but this eliminates the endpoint's actual capability (compiling admin-submitted rule source) entirely - disclosed as requiring a code-review/deploy cycle for new rules.

R235.note: Removes the is_staff widening so all users (including staff) are scoped to owner=self.request.user, matching the documented policy.

R237.note: Adds explicit IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync() call, which is required for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints since UseAntiforgery() alone doesn't validate them.

R238.note: HtmlEncode applied at the actual output sink, correct.

R239.note: Correct HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() fix for both parameters (the write-up's 'Source' code block confusingly already shows the encoded version, but the described fix and diff are accurate).

R240.note: Adds caller.Role != "admin" check using the real Role field, placed correctly before the sink.

R241.note: Minimal, correct setSecure(true) fix; leaves a pre-existing (untouched) response message that still says 'secure flag set to: false', a minor stale string not introduced by this diff.

R242.note: Rejects separators/stream-wrapper syntax then canonicalizes with realpath() and checks containment; closes both traversal and wrapper bypass without affecting legitimate single-filename requests.

R243.note: Sequelize replacements with named placeholders, semantics preserved exactly.

R244.note: Switches to html/template with correct field names (Author, Excerpt) and matching Render(c Comment) error signature.

R245.note: SandboxedEnvironment is the canonical Jinja2 fix for untrusted templates; render_preview() interface and return contract unchanged.

R246.note: Allowlist map of sort keys with a safe default for unmatched input; reasonable given no canonical sort-mode list is defined in the case, and the fallback is disclosed.

R247.note: Core fix (lockoutOnFailure:true, resolve user via TUser overload) is correct, but the added timing-mitigation calls PasswordHasher.HashPasswordAsync, which doesn't exist on IPasswordHasher<TUser> (only sync HashPassword) - won't compile as written.

R248.note: Bounds check against MAX_FIELDS before array access, correct and minimal.

R249.note: Denylist replaced with extension+MIME allowlist, the correct remediation shape; narrowing of accepted types is inherent to the fix and disclosed.

R250.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both injection points, standard correct fix.

R251.note: Replaces shell ping with a TCP connect to port 80, which is a fundamentally different check (fails for any up host without a web server on port 80); the explanation falsely claims this 'correctly maps to the original ping exit code behavior', misrepresenting a real behavior change as equivalent.

R252.note: Replaces string-eval assert() with a direct boolean check/throw, closing the injection and (as a side effect) making the access check actually enforce in production where zend.assertions is normally disabled.

R253.note: Argument-array + shell=False is the right general pattern for CWE-78, but on Windows subprocess.Popen cannot directly launch a .bat file without cmd.exe/shell=True - this would fail every invocation with WinError 193, undisclosed.

R254.note: OrderSecurity.isOwner() calls order.getOwnerId(), a method that doesn't exist on the actual Order entity (only getCustomerUsername()) - won't compile as written.

R255.note: Wrapping ruleSource text in "(function(){return(...);})" is not a real sandbox: an attacker can supply an IIFE as the 'expression' (e.g. containing java.lang.Runtime.getRuntime().exec(...)) that executes before the return, so RCE remains fully possible via Nashorn's default Java interop; it also breaks legitimate multi-statement rules since only a single expression now parses.

R256.note: execFileSync with argument array plus filename/geometry allowlisting via regex, correct.

R257.note: Uses the existing findByOwnerUsername() method, exactly matching the stated contract.

R258.note: Structured slog.String attribute is correctly escaped for control characters by both TextHandler and JSONHandler, closing the log injection; response behavior to the client unchanged.

R259.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting RestoredSession and String matches the documented contract exactly (IllegalArgumentException on rejection, legitimate fields still restored).

R260.note: Standard parameterized SqlDataAdapter/SqlCommand fix, preserves DataTable shape exactly.
